tools.name: addLedgerEntries
tools.reason: Appends directives and may add include lines in the selected ledger.
tools.destructiveEffects: Only adds ledger directives/include references; it does not replace or remove existing entries.

tools.name: appendLedgerText
tools.reason: Appends supplied directive text to the selected ledger.
tools.destructiveEffects: Only appends text and needed include references; existing text is not replaced or deleted.

tools.name: insertReceiptTransaction
tools.reason: Copies a caller-owned upload to receipt storage, appends an entry and consumes the temporary upload.
tools.destructiveEffects: After successful entry commit it deletes the original temporary upload; preserving a permanent copy does not make that deletion additive.

tools.name: parseReceipt
tools.reason: Sends the caller-owned upload for extraction/account recommendations and consumes persisted AI quota.
tools.destructiveEffects: It does not delete or overwrite ledger entries or the source upload; AI usage is disclosed as a stateful cost.

tools.name: parseFile
tools.reason: Processes a caller-owned upload through AI and consumes persisted AI quota.
tools.destructiveEffects: It returns parsed rows without deleting the upload or replacing/deleting ledger entries; quota consumption is disclosed.

tools.name: generateTempAssetUploadUrl
tools.reason: Issues a new caller-bound presigned PUT capability and unique temporary object key.
tools.destructiveEffects: The capability targets a fresh temporary key; this call does not overwrite/delete an existing object or commit an entry.

tools.name: createLedgerFiles
tools.reason: Commits new files to the selected ledger.
tools.destructiveEffects: Creates new paths; an already existing target is refused rather than overwritten.

tools.name: updateLedgerFiles
tools.reason: Commits replacements to existing ledger files.
tools.destructiveEffects: Replaces existing file contents, even when a commit can later be reverted.

tools.name: deleteLedgerFiles
tools.reason: Commits removal of selected ledger files.
tools.destructiveEffects: Deletes existing paths and content; include guards limit but do not remove that destructive capability.

tools.name: updateEntrySource
tools.reason: Commits replacement source for an existing entry.
tools.destructiveEffects: Overwrites existing entry text; optimistic hashes and optional previews do not change the committed branch's effect.

tools.name: deleteEntrySource
tools.reason: Commits removal of one selected entry's source.
tools.destructiveEffects: Deletes an existing entry; optional dry_run is not the only accepted mode.

tools.name: deleteEntrySources
tools.reason: Commits removal of several selected entry sources.
tools.destructiveEffects: Deletes existing entries in the committed mode, regardless of preview support.

tools.name: renameLedgerFile
tools.reason: Commits a new path and removal of the original, optionally rewriting include directives.
tools.destructiveEffects: Deletes the old path and can overwrite includer contents; content preservation and a reversible commit do not make this additive.

tools.name: setLedgerStar
tools.reason: Sets or removes the caller's personal ledger-star relationship.
tools.destructiveEffects: starred:false removes an existing star relationship; reversibility does not make removal additive. It never deletes the ledger.

tools.name: refreshManagedPrices
tools.reason: Fetches configured public price feeds and updates derived refresh/cache status.
tools.destructiveEffects: Refreshes derived feed data/status only; it does not delete source configuration or replace authored ledger files/entries.

tools.name: syncBankTransactions
tools.reason: Fetches provider changes, creates/modifies/removes staged rows and advances the stored sync cursor.
tools.destructiveEffects: Applies modified provider rows and deletes removed staged transactions; it is not only an additive fetch.

tools.name: importStagedBankTransactions
tools.reason: Appends selected staged rows as ledger entries and marks their source rows as synced.
tools.destructiveEffects: Adds ledger entries and retains the source transaction records with import status; it does not replace/delete authored entries.

tools.name: discardStagedBankTransactions
tools.reason: Removes selected rows from bank staging.
tools.destructiveEffects: Deletes stored staged transaction records.

tools.name: reconcileBankAccounts
tools.reason: Reconciles stored bank accounts against the provider's current account set.
tools.destructiveEffects: Can remove obsolete bank-account records and replace their associated state.

tools.name: mapBankAccount
tools.reason: Sets a linked bank account's target ledger-account mapping.
tools.destructiveEffects: Can overwrite an existing mapping, changing how later imports are classified.

tools.name: setBankAccountCurrency
tools.reason: Sets the stored currency for the selected bank account.
tools.destructiveEffects: Can overwrite an existing currency choice used by subsequent imports.

tools.name: refreshBankConnection
tools.reason: Refreshes the existing provider link's derived status and errors.
tools.destructiveEffects: Does not unlink the bank, revoke access or replace authored ledger content; it refreshes existing derived status only.

tools.name: unlinkBankConnection
tools.reason: Removes the bank connection and its local related records and revokes provider access.
tools.destructiveEffects: Revokes access and deletes connection/account data.

tools.name: listBankConnections
tools.reason: Reads the caller-authorized existing bank links/accounts; it does not refresh, link or unlink a bank.
tools.proposedApproval: Host read policy; no automatic approval asserted
tools.destructiveEffects: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.

tools.name: listStagedBankTransactions
tools.reason: Reads caller-authorized staged bank rows without fetching, importing or discarding them.
tools.proposedApproval: Host read policy; no automatic approval asserted
tools.destructiveEffects: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.

tools.name: createPullRequest
tools.reason: Creates a fresh proposal branch, its proposed files and a new pull request.
tools.destructiveEffects: Changes are isolated to the newly created branch; the existing base branch and existing pull requests are not overwritten/closed.

tools.name: mergePullRequest
tools.reason: Merges proposed changes into the existing base branch.
tools.destructiveEffects: Can overwrite or remove existing base-branch content as the proposal is applied.

tools.name: rejectPullRequest
tools.reason: Closes the selected existing pull request without merging it.
tools.destructiveEffects: Cancels/closes an existing proposal, changing its lifecycle state.

tools.name: createLedger
tools.reason: Creates a new ledger and requested initial files.
tools.destructiveEffects: Adds a new repository; existing ledgers are not overwritten or removed.

tools.name: previewLedgerSetup
tools.reason: Computes proposed setup files and validation in memory; it creates no ledger, file or job.
tools.proposedApproval: Host read policy; no automatic approval asserted
tools.destructiveEffects: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.

tools.name: updateLedger
tools.reason: Changes existing ledger metadata or privacy.
tools.destructiveEffects: Can replace settings, rename the ledger or change its visibility; optional preview does not limit committed capabilities.

tools.name: deleteLedger
tools.reason: Permanently removes an existing ledger and its history.
tools.destructiveEffects: Deletes the ledger, contents and history in committed mode.

tools.name: setLedgerCollaborator
tools.reason: Adds a collaborator or updates their stored permission.
tools.destructiveEffects: Can replace/downgrade existing access; adding-only is not the sole accepted behavior.

tools.name: removeLedgerCollaborator
tools.reason: Removes an existing collaborator's access.
tools.destructiveEffects: Revokes the selected collaborator's permission in committed mode.

tools.name: leaveLedger
tools.reason: Removes the authenticated collaborator's own access.
tools.destructiveEffects: Revokes the caller's existing access in committed mode.
